> **Base branch:** `develop` (features/fixes) · `main` (release PRs only)

## Summary

<!-- What does this PR do? -->

## Type

- [ ] `feat` — new user-visible feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` — internal change, no behaviour change
- [ ] `chore` — deps, scripts, version bump
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only

## Checklist

- [ ] `swift build` passes
- [ ] `swift test` passes
- [ ] **CHANGELOG.md updated** (skip only for `chore` / `docs` / `refactor`)
